Prisma Initiation Steps

edit
1. npm i @prisma/client
2. npm i prisma
3. npx prisma init --datasource-provider [sqlite]
4. Update schema.prisma file by updating "prisma-client" to "prisma-client-js" and only have the provider in the client generator. Also, you must add a model. 
5. npx prisma migrate dev (run every time a model is added or updated)
